svg.title: D4 A mode lights up weights and neurons
svg.desc: Since ∇_{W₁}ℒ = Σ_i g_i b_i^T [thm, A3], a mode shades layer-L units by b_i, pre-activations by g_i, W_1 edges by |g_{i,k} b_{i,j}|. Edges: a basis-dependent gradient contribution, not a weight or a mechanism; only block sums and interactions are invariant.
